snippet.title: GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM | Neural Migration - Silvered Whispers Preview Video
snippet.description:
Time-Limited Event [Neural Migration - Silvered Whispers] will be open from May 22. During the event, Commanders can receive generous rewards including [Collapse Pieces], [Targeted Access Permissions], [Basic Info Cores] by participating in event Game Modes.

[Duration] 
2025/5/22 09:00 ~ 2025/6/11 18:59(GMT+0)
The event shop exchange will expire at 2025/6/18 18:59(GMT+0)

[Unlock Conditions] 
Commander Level 20
